Review pending pathology cases in a simulated hospital LIMS and submit an ICD-10-coded diagnostic report.

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Dense, per step

Deterministic graders reward lookups, critical flags, ICD-10 code and severity, and penalise false positives; scores are bounded 0.01 to 0.99.
